_readme: Coordinates in this file did NOT come from the 32 paired perspective research documents in data/raw/ -- they were located afterward via AI-assisted research to fill map coordinate gaps, then independently cross-checked in a second pass. Every entry says so in its own note text; build_territories.py must never present these as if they were part of the original perspective research. Where two sources reported different coordinates for what is described as the same feature, BOTH are kept as separate entries -- not averaged, not resolved in favor of whichever source sounds more authoritative. This file does not, and must not, attempt to attribute funding or institutional motive behind any source -- that framing invites unverifiable conspiracy narratives regardless of what fills it in, and has no place in a project built on documented, attributed fact.
